lines: Be still, and know that I am God:
I will be exalted among the heathen,
I will be exalted in the earth.
Fear thou not; for I am with thee:
be not dismayed; for I am thy God:
I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee;
yea, I will uphold thee
with the right hand of my righteousness.

title2: Be Strong And Of A Good Courage
lines: Have not I commanded thee?
Be strong and of a good courage;
be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed:
for the LORD thy God is with thee
whithersoever thou goest.

say: Lamentations three, verses twenty-two and twenty-three.
lines: It is of the LORD'S mercies
that we are not consumed,
because his compassions fail not.
They are new every morning:
great is thy faithfulness.
I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep:
for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

title2: Cast Thy Burden Upon The LORD
lines: Cast thy burden upon the LORD,
and he shall sustain thee:
he shall never suffer the righteous
to be moved.
Now the God of hope fill you
with all joy and peace in believing,
that ye may abound in hope,
through the power of the Holy Ghost.

title2: My Peace I Give Unto You
lines: Peace I leave with you,
my peace I give unto you:
not as the world giveth, give I unto you.
Let not your heart be troubled,
neither let it be afraid.
I laid me down and slept;
I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
For God hath not given us the spirit of fear;
but of power, and of love,
and of a sound mind.
It is vain for you to rise up early,
to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows:
for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

say: Psalm one hundred nineteen, verse one hundred five.
lines: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet,
and a light unto my path.
The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble;
and he knoweth them that trust in him.

title2: Cause Me To Know The Way
say: Psalm one hundred forty-three, verse eight.
lines: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning;
for in thee do I trust:
cause me to know the way wherein I should walk;
for I lift up my soul unto thee.
